components.name: ai.jarvis.reconciler
components.purpose: Desired-state reconciler (K8s-style level-triggered control loop). Reads desired-state.json (never writes it), diffs desired-vs-actual fleet state, acts per the action matrix (kickstart lanes, re-register crons, surface other drift). Exits 2 by DESIGN when drift was detected and at least one action was taken — that is success-with-action, NOT a failure. The earlier exit-2 'failing' read was a misclassification (INC-2026-06-18).
components.health_check: launchctl list ai.jarvis.reconciler (LastExitStatus 512 = exit 2 = drift-fixed = HEALTHY); ~/.cortextos/logs/reconciler.err.log size 0 = no error; out.log tail shows "[reconciler] exit=2 (drift-fixed)"
